description:
Brophy Estates are delighted to bring to the market 163 Biscayne, an attractive four-bedroom semi-detached home situated in a mature and well-established residential area on the coast.

This spacious property offers well-proportioned accommodation throughout and provides an excellent opportunity for those seeking a comfortable home in a convenient coastal location.

On entering the property, the dual-aspect living/dining room provides a bright and welcoming reception space, with patio doors opening directly onto the mature private west-facing rear garden. The garden features both a patio area and lawn, making it ideal for outdoor entertaining or simply relaxing in a private setting.

A separate modern fully fitted kitchen is positioned to the rear and benefits from integrated appliances. To the front of the property is a versatile office/study room, ideal for those working from home, along with a convenient downstairs WC.

Upstairs, there are four generous bedrooms, including a well-proportioned main bedroom with its own dressing room. A family bathroom completes the accommodation at first-floor level.

Externally, the property benefits from a cobble-lock driveway to the front, providing off-street parking, while the mature west-facing rear garden offers excellent privacy.

Located within a popular and established coastal residential area, 163 Biscayne is conveniently positioned for a host of local amenities, schools, transport links and the coastline. The property combines generous accommodation, private outdoor space and a highly desirable setting.

Triple-glazed windows installed in 2024

Curtains, carpets and blinds included in the sale

Viewing is highly recommended to appreciate all that this lovely property has to offer.
